boundary: Prospective S7 exact/close novelty and duplication query control. The query tests contribution vocabulary and close planning predecessors without requiring exact predecessor titles. Developmental only: not a frozen search, screening or eligibility decision, PRISMA input, or final novelty finding.

queries.query: ("verified delivery capacity" OR "role-stage demand" OR "hybrid intelligence effort" OR "LLM-aware software effort" OR "agentic cost estimation" OR "AI-augmented engineering" OR "human-AI software delivery" OR ("story point" AND (LLM OR "large language model")) OR ("AI-assisted" AND "software effort"))

+("verified delivery capacity" | "role stage demand" | "hybrid intelligence effort" | "LLM aware software effort" | "agentic cost estimation" | "AI augmented engineering" | "human AI software delivery" | ("story point" + (LLM | "large language model")) | ("AI assisted" + "software effort"))

arxiv_query.query: (all:"verified delivery capacity" OR all:"role-stage demand" OR all:"hybrid intelligence effort" OR all:"LLM-aware software effort" OR all:"agentic cost estimation" OR all:"AI-augmented engineering" OR all:"human-AI software delivery" OR (all:"story point" AND (all:LLM OR all:"large language model")) OR (all:"AI-assisted" AND all:"software effort"))

sentinels.title: Hybrid intelligence effort for software effort estimation in LLM assisted development
sentinels.rationale: Closest empirical task-level effort predecessor; omission would invalidate the overlap control.

sentinels.title: Toward LLM-aware software effort estimation: a conceptual framework
sentinels.rationale: Conceptual HIE/LLM-aware predecessor constraining any claim that oversight-aware estimation is new.

sentinels.title: Agentic Cost Estimation Model (ACEM): A Framework for Predicting Costs in Agentic Software Development
sentinels.rationale: Cost/HITL predecessor spanning human, model, infrastructure, context, and revision factors.

sentinels.title: Agile V: A Compliance-Ready Framework for AI-Augmented Engineering -- From Concept to Audit-Ready Delivery
sentinels.rationale: Lifecycle/gate predecessor spanning requirements, design, build, testing, compliance, and human approval.

sentinels.title: Orchestrating Human-AI Software Delivery: A Retrospective Longitudinal Field Study of Three Software Modernization Programs
sentinels.rationale: Closest lifecycle delivery-orchestration evidence; tests overlap with coordinated human-AI stages and delivery outcomes.

sentinels.title: Story Point Estimation Using Large Language Models
sentinels.rationale: Counterweight to categorical replacement language: retains Story Points as an AI-assisted estimation target.

sentinels.title: LLMs’ reshaping of people, processes, products, and society in software development: a qualitative exploration with early adopters
sentinels.rationale: Observed practitioner evidence constrains universal productivity and lifecycle-shift premises.

sentinels.title: Agentic Self-Healing for Data and AI Pipelines: An Affordable Vendor-Agnostic Architecture using Open-Source Software
sentinels.rationale: Agentic pipeline operations without software-team planning or verified-completion forecasting is a precision boundary; retrieval is undesirable but not a recall failure.
